examples: status_line link columns +2: [a3s] (6 cols) -> [Aster] (8 cols); a3s (3 cols) -> aster (5 cols)

intentional_effort_menu.change: expect ['Default','low','medium','high','xhigh','max'] and selected index 3; assertions kept exact

contradictory_assertions.root_cause: brand-cleanup commit 0935a85a6 introduced !text.contains("aster") in the same test that requires 'Run `aster login`'
contradictory_assertions.change: removed the two impossible assertions (each test keeps 3-5 meaningful assertions); renamed ..._suggests_grok_login to ..._suggests_aster_login

short_terminal_leaves_the_row_four_of_it.classification: product layout decision required, not a stale expectation
short_terminal_leaves_the_row_four_of_it.evidence: at 16 rows the borderless prompt draws two upper/lower half-block vpad rows (views/prompt_widget/mod.rs:3172, intentional visual design), so the status script keeps only row-1..row-3; the test asserts row-4 survives
short_terminal_leaves_the_row_four_of_it.follow_up: decide whether short terminals should suppress vpad; changing the assertion to 3 rows would weaken the short-terminal usability contract

shell_aliases_expand_to_exact_argv_and_b.classification: test harness / environment defect with a network side effect
shell_aliases_expand_to_exact_argv_and_b.evidence: bash -ic "source rc; source rc; eval 'ssh -p 2222 host'" never expands the alias because -c parses the whole command before the alias exists; the real ssh runs, connects to the sandbox proxy 198.18.4.254:2222 and exits 255. Reproduced manually with shopt -s expand_aliases as well.
shell_aliases_expand_to_exact_argv_and_b.follow_up: redesign the fixture (e.g. bash --rcfile with a separate command line) so the capture assertion actually runs; do not just relax status.success()

rendered_user_and_streaming_markdown_com.classification: suspected product defect, not yet localized
rendered_user_and_streaming_markdown_com.evidence: at width=18 the magenta highlighted text is only '/acme:review'; '/model' is not highlighted even though slash/highlight.rs explicitly rejoins soft wraps to keep one command identity
rendered_user_and_streaming_markdown_com.follow_up: inspect ResolvedSelectionModel ranges/lines at width=18 and find why the first command's token is dropped
